headline: Illustrative sample: two gaps to fill and one line to grow into
summary: This sample uses made-up brands and ASINs to show the report format. In a real run every number comes from public Amazon pages read during that run. Here, a matcha brand sells one ceremonial powder in two sizes while its closest competitors sell sticks, latte mixes and starter kits.
top_picks: Single-serve stick packs: 4 of 5 competitors sell them
Unsweetened latte mix: shoppers ask for it in reviews
Matcha starter kit: whisk and bowl show up in bought-together on every top listing

catalog.notes: Sample data. A real run lists the brand's listings found on Amazon.

opportunities.name: Single-serve stick packs
opportunities.what: Launch a 30-count box of 1g ceremonial sticks for on-the-go shoppers.
evidence: 4 of 5 competitors sell a stick format
No stick listing from the seller
customer_signals: Wish this came in travel packets
opportunities.differentiation: Ceremonial grade sticks are rare; most are culinary grade.
opportunities.risks: Packaging cost per serving is higher.

opportunities.name: Unsweetened latte mix
opportunities.what: Add a ready latte blend with no added sugar.
evidence: Most latte mixes on page one list sugar first
customer_signals: Too sweet, I want just matcha and milk powder

opportunities.name: Matcha starter kit
opportunities.what: Bundle powder, bamboo whisk and bowl as one gift ready listing.
evidence: Whisk appears in bought-together on 5 of 6 top listings
opportunities.differentiation: Lead with the powder quality competitors' kits skimp on.

coverage.notes: Illustrative sample only. Brands, ASINs and numbers are made up.
